description: The secondary-scoring portion of a rescore stage: a query whose score is blended with the original score.

rescore_query.description: Required. The query used to re-score the top window of hits.

query_weight.description: Optional. Weight applied to the original query score. Default 1.0.

rescore_query_weight.description: Optional. Weight applied to the rescore-query score. Default 1.0.

score_mode.description: Optional. How the two scores combine: total (default), multiply, avg, max, or min.
